notes.title: Patch 1.4.0
notes.content:
[h1][b]Patch 1.4.0
[/b][/h1]


[b]New Additions [/b]

-Added Spell names
-Added new Reforge Spell
-Added option to turn off and on V-sync


[b]Changes[/b]

-Made the game generally easier
-Removed graphics setting option as it didn't really do anything.
-Updated how damage is calculated, (Damaged is calculated by player strength divided by 2, before it was only full numbers but now it takes decimal places into account. for example having 3 strength now deals 1.5 damage rather than 1)
-You now get full time back when you beat the level objective
-Boss skulls now also give you full time back
-Changed how the Strength Agility and luck boost spells work, they are now time limited
-Sped up the opening intro screen
-Shortened the height of the Dungeon Tower Room
-Removed a lot of the foliage from the Cemetery Room
-Lowered the amount of enemies in certain rooms especially the Sewers  
-Rare Items now also drop an extra Repair item.
-Lowered the height of the Garden Maze. 


[b]Fixes[/b]

Fixed about 1001 different bugs and issues
Made further optimizations. 

As always any issues/bugs please email me at contact@lesserfate.com, @lesserfate on X or on the Steam discussion board.

Also if you like the game please leave a review as it really helps me with the algorithm, Thanks.

notes.title: Patch 1.3.0
notes.content:
[b]Patch 1.3.0

Visibility, difficulty and rudimentary VR support.[/b]

-Increased the overall visibility, raised the gamma, texture emissive maps and fade out distance.
-Decreased the vignette when underwater.
-Motion Blur is now off by default.
-Increased the size of the Pull-Switches in the Furnace and Recycling Boss fights.
-Grain Filter now scales with resolution, improves visibility for lower resolutions (Steam Decks etc.)
-Added the ability to skip the intro by press the "jump" key.
-Changed the HP of the shield from 100 to 150.
-Base agility is now set to 2 from 1.
-For VR compatibility you can now turn off the crosshair by pressing the "home" key you can also set the camera ratio to 16:9 by pressing the "end" key.

I've had a lot of feedback about not been able to skip the tutorial, there is already a tutorial skip in the game (there's actually 2) but It seems to be more obscure than I original thought and intended, There was some barrels you could jump onto to get onto the walkway that leads outside, I have changed the barrels for boxes as the barrels get knocked over quite easily.

Any issues/bugs please email me at contact@lesserfate.com, @lesserfate on X or on the Steam discussion board thanks.

notes.title: Patch 1.0.3 Minor Fixes/Alterations
notes.content:
Patch 1.0.3 Minor Fixes/Alterations

-Added a delay to the lift door, it now won't close again until its fully opened.
-Reworded the tutorial text for using the key
-Added extra tutorial for jumping/crouch jumping
-Added text for a failed unlock spell at the locked tutorial door (this was causing confusion for new players as they were semi-soft-locking the game)
-Reworked the default controls to be more accommodating for keyboards with a US layout.
-Fixed enemy footsteps in shallow water, you can hear them now.
-Fixed the debris from breakable boxes.
-Fixed been able to skip two 3rd's of the game using the teleportation spell.

Any issues please email me at contact@lesserfate.com or @lesserfate on twitter, thanks.
